import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from harness import *

def low(pn,w): return pn & ((1<<(8*w))-1)
def reconstruct(raw,w,expected):
    m=1<<(8*w); k=(expected-raw)//m
    base=raw+k*m
    if base<0: return base+m
    nxt=base+m
    return base if (expected-base)<(nxt-expected) else nxt
def canonw(pn,expected):
    for w in [1,2,3]:
        if reconstruct(low(pn,w),w,expected)==pn: return w
    return 4
def longhdr(level,pn,payload,dcid=b'\xaa',scid=b'\xbb',token=b'',expected=0,width=None):
    w=canonw(pn,expected) if width is None else width
    first=(0xc0 if level=='I' else 0xe0)|(w-1)
    h=bytes([first])+b'\0\0\0\1'+bytes([len(dcid)])+dcid+bytes([len(scid)])+scid
    if level=='I': h+=v(len(token))+token
    h+=v(w+len(payload))+low(pn,w).to_bytes(w,'big')+payload
    return h
def shorthdr(pn,payload,dcid=b'\xaa',phase=0,expected=0):
    w=canonw(pn,expected)
    return bytes([0x40|(phase<<2)|(w-1)])+dcid+low(pn,w).to_bytes(w,'big')+payload

AKEYS={'keys':['A']}

# ---- crypto overlong varints narrowed ----
payload = b'\x06'+v(0,width=2)+v(3,width=2)+b'abc'
w = longhdr('I',0,payload)
tr = trace([datagram(w,[0])]); t=one(tr)
exp = longhdr('I',0,b'\x06\x00\x03abc')
check('crypto-narrow',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][0]['sha256'],t['datagrams'][0]['bytes']),( 'OK',sha(exp),len(exp)))
check('crypto-ledger',(t['crypto'][0]['ranges'],t['crypto'][0]['unique'],t['crypto'][0]['prefix'],t['crypto'][0]['sha256']),([[0,3]],3,3,sha(b'abc')))

# ---- padding each byte a frame ----
payload=b'\x00\x00\x01'
w=longhdr('I',0,payload); tr=trace([datagram(w,[0])]); t=one(tr)
check('padding', t['packets'][0]['sha256'], sha(longhdr('I',0,b'\x00\x00\x01')))

# ---- ack frame canonical + union ----
# largest=5, delay=0, count=1, first=2 -> [3,5]; then gap=1,range=1 -> low=3, high=3-1-2=0, range<=0 -> [0,0]
payload=b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(1)+v(2)+v(1)+v(1)
w=longhdr('I',0,payload); tr=trace([datagram(w,[0])]); t=one(tr)
exp=longhdr('I',0,b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(1)+v(2)+v(1)+v(1))
check('ack-canon',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][0]['sha256']),('OK',sha(exp)))
check('ack-union',(t['acknowledged'][0]['count'],t['acknowledged'][0]['intervals'],t['acknowledged'][0]['prefix'],t['acknowledged'][0]['sha256']),
      (5,2,0,sha(b''.join([ (0).to_bytes(8,'big'),(1).to_bytes(8,'big'),(3).to_bytes(8,'big'),(6).to_bytes(8,'big')]))))
# second ack making adjacency merge: largest=2 first=2 -> [0,2]
tr = trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(1)+v(2)+v(1)+v(1)),[0]),
            datagram(longhdr('I',1,b'\x02'+v(2)+v(0)+v(0)+v(2)),[0])])
t=one(tr)
check('ack-merge',(t['acknowledged'][0]['count'],t['acknowledged'][0]['intervals'],t['acknowledged'][0]['prefix']),
      (6,1,6))
check('ack-merge-hash',t['acknowledged'][0]['sha256'],sha((0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(6).to_bytes(8,'big')))
# ack ecn
payload=b'\x03'+v(5)+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)+v(1)+v(2)+v(3)
tr=trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,payload),[0])]); t=one(tr)
check('ack-ecn',t['acknowledged'][0]['ecn'],[1,2,3])
check('ack-ecn-count',(t['acknowledged'][0]['count'],t['acknowledged'][0]['intervals'],t['acknowledged'][0]['prefix']),(6,1,6))

# ---- ack arithmetic errors ----
for name,payload in [
    ('ack-first-gt', b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(0)+v(6)),
    ('ack-gap', b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(1)+v(0)+v(9)+v(0)),
    ('ack-range', b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(1)+v(0)+v(1)+v(2)),
    ('ack-trunc', b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(2)+v(0)),

]:

# ---- CLOSE handling ----
payload=b'\x01'+b'\x1c'+v(9)+v(0)+v(0)
tr=trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,payload),[0])]); t=one(tr)
check('close',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['closed']['code'],t['closed']['offset'],t['closed']['event'],t['closed']['packet']),( 'PEER_CLOSE',9,1,0,0))
check('close-hash',t['packets'][0]['sha256'],sha(longhdr('I',0,b'\x01\x1c'+v(9)+v(0)+v(0))))
check('close-accepted',t['datagrams'][0]['accepted'],1)
# trailing bytes ignored
payload=b'\x1c'+v(9)+v(0)+v(0)+b'\xff\xff'
tr=trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,payload),[0])]); t=one(tr)
check('close-trailing',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][0]['sha256']),('PEER_CLOSE',sha(longhdr('I',0,b'\x1c'+v(9)+v(0)+v(0)))))
# later packets CLOSED, key events ignored
tr=trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,b'\x1c'+v(9)+v(0)+v(0)),[0]),{'keys':['A']},
          datagram(longhdr('I',1,b'\x01'),[0]), datagram(longhdr('I',2,b'\x10'+v(5)),[0])])
t=one(tr)
check('closed-later',(t['packets'][1]['status'],t['packets'][2]['status'],t['keys'],t['send_max_data']),('CLOSED','CLOSED',['I'],0))
# BAD_HEADER after close
tr=trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,b'\x1c'+v(9)+v(0)+v(0)),[0]), datagram(b'\x00',[0])])
t=one(tr); check('badhdr-after-close',(t['packets'][1]['status'],t['closed']['code']),( 'BAD_HEADER',9))
# a frame error does NOT close the connection: later packet still OK
tr=trace([datagram(longhdr('I',0,b'\x20'),[0]), datagram(longhdr('I',1,b'\x01'),[0])])
t=one(tr); check('error-not-close',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['packets'][1]['status'],t['closed']),( 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR','OK',None))

# ---- rollback within a packet ----
tr=trace([AKEYS, datagram(shorthdr(0, b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(1)+b'a'+b'\x20'),[0])])
t=one(tr)
check('rollback',(t['packets'][0]['status'],t['streams'],t['used'],t['opened']),( 'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',[],0,{'bidi':0,'uni':0}))
# prior packet committed
tr=trace([AKEYS, datagram(shorthdr(0,b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(1)+b'a')),[0]])
tr['events']=[AKEYS, datagram(shorthdr(0,b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(1)+b'a'),[0]), datagram(shorthdr(1,b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(1)+b'b'+b'\x20'),[0])]
t=one(tr)
check('rollback-prior',(t['packets'][1]['status'],t['streams'][0]['ranges'],t['streams'][0]['unique']),('FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',[[0,1]],1))

# ---- multiple envelopes in a datagram ----
d = longhdr('I',0,b'\x01')+longhdr('I',1,b'\x01')
tr=trace([datagram(d,[0])]); t=one(tr)
